title: August 2025 Auckland D365 BC User Group Event
summary: A personal reflection on presenting at the Auckland D365 Business Central User Group event, highlighting the value of community engagement and sharing knowledge with peers in the BC community.
key_points: Community user groups provide valuable opportunities to share tips and best practices with fellow Business Central professionals
Networking and conversations at user group events are as important as formal presentations
Adopting a learn-and-share culture within the BC community creates rewarding professional experiences
